title: [Bug] Stop Hook Provides Stale Transcript Path
body:
**Bug Description**
  Bug: Stop hook transcript_path points to stale file

  The transcript_path in Stop hook payloads points to an outdated transcript instead of the actively-updated one.

  Evidence:
  - Hook provides: 986acdc8-4aec-4971-9a2d-7388e06052ce.jsonl (1107 lines, unchanged)
  - Actual active file: ca9abf47-ece8-4e6e-8d1d-7ab48d5561be.jsonl (actively updated)
  - Both have same session_id but different UUIDs

  Impact: Hooks reading transcript get stale data (our TTS read old messages repeatedly)

  Workaround: Find most recently modified .jsonl file in project dir instead of trusting provided path


**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: windsurf
- Version: 2.0.1
- Feedback ID: 0e863616-ae56-413d-a691-264459c9c695
